KnowBe4 (KnowBe4, Inc., Clearwater FL) is a security awareness training and phishing simulation platform. The SLA targets 99.9% monthly uptime using "commercially reasonable efforts" language — it is a target, not a hard guarantee. Credits are issued as additional subscription days (max 10 days per subscription year), applied as a prorated discount on the next renewal rather than as a monetary credit. Credits are forfeited if not used in the following subscription term.
